senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n., נְהַר כ׳ river (or channel) K’bar (Chebar) in Babylonia.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:3">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>הוא פרת הוא נ׳ כ׳</he> Euphrates and K. are the same.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:3">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ בפני עצמו וכ׳</he> K. and Euphrates are different rivers.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:3">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ שמימיו כלין</he> it is called K’bar (v. <cite ref="K00072">next w.</cite>), because its waters give out; <he>שפירותיו גסין ואינן יורדין בכברה</he> because its fruits are large and go not into the basket; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 22:7">Yalk. Gen. 22</cite> <he>שמימיו קַלִּין</he>).
